description.value:
With a soothing gesture you settle up to three willing creatures you can see within range into a deep, restorative slumber for the duration. The power ends early for a target that takes damage or is shaken or slapped awake. A target that remains asleep for the full duration gains the benefit of a short rest and cannot be affected by this power again until it completes a long rest. Droids and constructs are unaffected.

Cast with a 4th-level slot or higher, you can affect one additional willing creature for each slot level above 3rd.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Light Side Powers, Level 3
